summary: ATIP feedback, canon's reading recorded: checker.md 1.3.1 L2.input-dash-values says 'a refusal whose field names that argument and whose received is the value also passes' and the §7.2 row says the same is 'none'. Read literally a USAGE or INPUT_INVALID refusal with that field and received would pass, yet the row above ('document value -x read as an option' fails) is exactly how such a refusal looks. canon's read_as_value requires a code that is not USAGE or INPUT_* (dc4c93c7); I confirmed on the checker that INPUT_INVALID/USAGE with received = the value fails and a precondition-class code passes (mutants 'framing codes count' and 'precondition never cannot-tell' are killed by atip_checkl2input_13). The text should say which codes count.
